proof:
Source: step 2 of the parent proof (openness of reg V in spt V, immediate from Definition 7.2), using fact (Sub). Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} and V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U. Write spt V := V.support and reg V := V.regularSet = {ξ : ξ ∈ spt V ∧ ∃ ρ > 0, IsC1Submanifold n (B̆_ρ(ξ) ∩ spt V)} (B̆ = open ball).
Dependency: child c1_submanifold_open_inter (Sub): IsC1Submanifold m S and B open imply IsC1Submanifold m (B ∩ S).
1. For each y ∈ reg V fix (by choice) ρ_y > 0 such that B̆_{ρ_y}(y) ∩ spt V is IsC1Submanifold n, and let O := ⋃_{y ∈ reg V} B̆_{ρ_y}(y). O is open, being a union of open balls.
2. reg V ⊆ O ∩ spt V: if y ∈ reg V then y ∈ spt V by definition and y ∈ B̆_{ρ_y}(y) ⊆ O since ρ_y > 0.
3. O ∩ spt V ⊆ reg V: let z ∈ O ∩ spt V, say z ∈ B̆_{ρ_y}(y) with y ∈ reg V. Put r := ρ_y - dist(z, y) > 0. By the triangle inequality B̆_r(z) ⊆ B̆_{ρ_y}(y), hence B̆_r(z) ∩ spt V = B̆_r(z) ∩ (B̆_{ρ_y}(y) ∩ spt V). By (Sub), applied to S := B̆_{ρ_y}(y) ∩ spt V and the open set B := B̆_r(z), this set is IsC1Submanifold n. Since also z ∈ spt V, z ∈ reg V (radius r).
4. Steps 1-3 give the open set O with V.regularSet = O ∩ V.support.
